title: Market Intel gating unification, route cleanup, unified theme + motion redesign, and new real-time pages

requirements.summary: Make AI Sentiment always visible inside Market Intel while keeping signals + market data fully gated and non-fetching until unlock.
acceptanceCriteria: When logged out or not unlocked, the Market Intel page still renders an AI Sentiment section with visible content.
Before unlock, no React Query requests for ['marketIntelligence', ...] or ['binarySignal', ...] execute and no market fetch is attempted.
After unlock, selecting an asset/timeframe triggers signals to load and render reliably for both Standard and Binary modes.

file_operations.description: Restructure the page so AI Sentiment renders regardless of lock state, while the Market Intelligence Signals area is replaced with a locked panel when not unlocked. Ensure gated queries and any market-data computation only run when unlocked (e.g., keep React Query enabled flags tied to unlock state and avoid any pre-unlock refetch triggers). Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Tabs, Alert, Dialog, Input, Button) to keep interaction patterns consistent; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Harden client-side gating by ensuring market intelligence and binary signal queries cannot execute until explicitly unlocked (including avoiding accidental background refetches when locked). Keep query keys consistent with existing usage so cache clearing remains effective.

requirements.summary: Update Market Intel lock/unlock UI/UX to show AI Sentiment always, provide locked panel unlock, add passcode-confirmed lock action, and clear state + cached results on lock.
acceptanceCriteria: When locked, the page shows AI Sentiment plus an unlock panel, and does not show any signal cards/indicator results.
When unlocked, the user can lock via a passcode confirmation dialog and the UI clears prior signal results.
After relock, revisiting the page does not show prior signals unless unlocked again.

file_operations.description: Replace the current full-page locked screen with an in-page 'Signals Locked' panel (passcode input + unlock action) while keeping AI Sentiment visible above it. When unlocked, add a prominent 'Lock Market Intel' control that opens a passcode confirmation dialog; on successful lock, clear selected asset/timeframe and trading mode dependent UI state, and ensure signal result sections are not rendered. Use shadcn-ui Dialog/Input/Button for the lock confirmation flow; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure React Query cache clearing/invalidation integrates cleanly with the lock/unlock mutations and access-check query so that a lock immediately prevents any gated reads and does not allow stale cached signal results to appear.

requirements.summary: Remove Live Price and Advanced Analytics from routing and navigation with no dead links.
acceptanceCriteria: BottomNav no longer displays 'Live Price' or 'Analytics'.
Navigating to /live-price or /advanced-analytics is not possible via in-app navigation and the routes are not registered in App routing.

file_operations.description: Remove imports and route registrations for the Live Price and Advanced Analytics pages so /live-price and /advanced-analytics are no longer part of the router tree.
Remove BottomNav items that navigate to /live-price and /advanced-analytics and confirm no other nav item labels or paths reference these removed routes.
Delete the Live Price page implementation file to prevent accidental future re-linking.
Delete the Advanced Analytics page implementation file to prevent accidental future re-linking.

requirements.summary: Unify theme, spacing, typography, and readability across Insights, Testimonials, Security, Highlights, and Ecosystem.
acceptanceCriteria: Insights, Testimonials, Security, Community Highlights, and Ecosystem pages share consistent background treatment, typography scale, and card styling.
No page has low-contrast text (readability issues) against its background.
Section headers and spacing patterns are consistent across these pages.

file_operations.description: Modernize to match the app-wide theme (consistent page shell/background, typography scale, section spacing, and card treatments). Replace any divergent font system usage with the unified theme utilities already used across the site.

Align page layout, section spacing, and card styling with the unified theme while preserving existing content structure. Continue using shadcn-ui Carousel for the testimonial slider; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Normalize backgrounds, card borders, and typography to match the same unified theme as other pages and ensure all text maintains strong contrast/readability.

Update styling to use the same page shell, header patterns, and card styling as other modernized pages (consistent spacing, borders, and readable contrast). Continue using shadcn-ui Badge where present; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Bring the Ecosystem page in line with the unified theme (header hierarchy, section rhythm, and card patterns) so it visually matches Insights/Testimonials/Security/Highlights.

Add or adjust shared theme utilities (page-shell variants, consistent section header spacing, and card defaults) to support the unified look across the specified pages without introducing new global stylesheet entry points.

requirements.summary: Add stronger site-wide motion design including parallax/ambient movement, noticeable reveals, and reusable smoky L↔R transitions.
acceptanceCriteria: Major page sections reveal with noticeable but readable animations (not just subtle fades).
At least one reusable smoky left↔right transition effect is applied consistently across multiple pages/sections.

file_operations.description: Introduce a reusable smoky left-to-right/right-to-left transition utility (e.g., via pseudo-elements + keyframes) and strengthen section reveal animations while respecting prefers-reduced-motion.

Create a reusable wrapper component that applies the smoky transition effect and a stronger reveal animation to sections. Use this component across multiple pages to ensure consistency; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a small hook to provide safe parallax/ambient movement values (scroll-based or pointer-based) with reduced-motion safeguards for use by multiple pages.
Apply the new motion system (stronger section reveals and at least one smoky transition between major sections) while keeping text readable and avoiding usability regressions.

Apply noticeable section reveals and the reusable smoky transition effect across AI Sentiment and Signals areas (and/or between major sub-sections) while ensuring locked-state UX remains clear. Use shadcn-ui components as already present; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Expand Whitepaper with additional chapters/coverage while keeping chapter navigation and scroll-based active tracking correct.
acceptanceCriteria: Whitepaper has noticeably more content (additional sections/chapters and deeper coverage).
Chapter sidebar navigation still scrolls to the correct sections and the active chapter updates while scrolling.

file_operations.description: Add new chapters and deepen content with structured subsections. Update the CHAPTERS list and ensure each new chapter has a matching section ref so IntersectionObserver tracking and sidebar navigation remain accurate. Continue using shadcn-ui ScrollArea/Button for the sidebar navigation; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add more FAQ entries with expandable answers and maintain consistent styling/readability.
acceptanceCriteria: FAQ includes additional Q/A entries beyond the current set.
Collapsible expand/collapse behavior remains functional and visually consistent.

file_operations.description: Expand the FAQ dataset with additional English Q/A entries, keeping answers well-structured and readable. Preserve and refine existing collapsible styling to match the unified theme. Continue using shadcn-ui Collapsible; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
If needed, adjust shared typography/spacing utilities used by FAQ items so the expanded content remains readable and consistent with the unified theme.

requirements.summary: Add at least two new real-time oriented pages/major sections (not Live Price/Advanced Analytics) and integrate them into navigation, theme, and motion system.
acceptanceCriteria: At least two new pages or major sections are added and are reachable from navigation.
New sections are consistent with the existing theme and use noticeable motion design.
New sections do not add back Live Price or Advanced Analytics pages.

file_operations.description: Create a new 'Market Pulse' page focused on real-time-oriented updates such as market narrative snapshots, sentiment pulses, macro event cards, and a lightweight data feed presentation (without being a Live Price page). Apply the unified theme and reusable smoky transition/reveal motion; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a new 'Alerts Center' page for professional, real-time-oriented workflows (e.g., watchlist-style reminders, local alert rules UI, and status panels) implemented client-side without WebSockets/chat and without reintroducing Live Price/Analytics. Apply the unified theme and reusable smoky transition/reveal motion; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Register routes for the new pages (e.g., /market-pulse and /alerts-center) in the TanStack Router tree and ensure they render inside the existing RootLayout.
Add navigation entries for the new real-time oriented pages and ensure ordering remains usable without reintroducing Live Price or Advanced Analytics entries.
Add any minimal shared styling utilities needed by the new pages to stay consistent with the unified theme and strengthened motion design.
